links.outcome: Readability (FRES, FKGL) of chatbot responses on cleft lip/palate feeding and oral health
links.effect: FRES 49.50 ± 10.33 (Gemini 3 Pro) vs 23.60 ± 14.48 (ChatGPT 5.2); FKGL 9.77 ± 1.54 vs 13.44 ± 2.81; both above plain-language levels, ChatGPT worse
links.quote: The FRES values were significantly higher for Gemini 3 Pro compared with ChatGPT 5.2 (49.50 ± 10.33 vs. 23.60 ± 14.48; p < 0.001), whereas the FKGL values were significantly lower (9.77 ± 1.54 vs. 13.44 ± 2.81; p < 0.001).

screen.reason: The study empirically evaluates and compares the baseline responses of two LLMs (ChatGPT and Gemini) to cleft lip and palate health questions without testing a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
